The '''Battle of Czerka 431''' was a minor battle that occurred during the [[Jedi Civil War]].

==Origins==
Following the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] alliance with the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], the Sith took direct control of the secret research facility, [[Czerka 431]]. There, they forced the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Joni Ree]] to perform experiments on [[Juggernaut war droid]]s. She disliked her new employers, so she contacted the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and gave them the location of the facility. She learned from them the scheduled time of their attack on it, so she could co-ordinate her escape attempt with this. Ree knew that the Sith would try to stun her during an escape attempt, so she also created a device to revive herself from such an attack.<ref name="Cz" />

==The battle==
The Republic sent a total of six troopers, and Ree was able to break out with the help of two Juggernaut droids, which came as a surprise to the Sith. The Sith troops responded by trying to kill all the Republic forces and capture Ree alive.<ref name="Cz" /> However, Ree was able to escape and started working for the Republic.<ref name="PD" />
